headline: Contact us

children.text: Whatever is on your heart — a prayer request, a question, or simply wanting to get in touch — we would be glad to hear from you.
The vicar aims to meet new members of the congregation for a 1-1 meeting within six months of their arrival.
The clergy can be reached through the Parish Office. If your enquiry concerns a baptism, wedding or funeral, do let us know and we will pass it to the right person.

The Church is open daily from 9am–7pm and you are always welcome to come in for prayer, to light a candle or leave a prayer request. When the main church is busy with other activities, the Lady Chapel (to the right of the Jesus statue as you come in) is always available as a quiet place to pray, read and reflect.
If you are unable to get to church, do ask about home communions — the clergy are glad to bring Holy Communion to those who need it.
